name: Integration Support
description: Declares external connector types that the Site implementation is prepared to support.
purpose: Allows integrations to be connected after launch through NEXT F CMS without hardcoding credentials into the customer website.

fields.description: Environment IDs where the connector may operate.
Whether the capability is currently permitted by this Site implementation.

relationships.description: connectorId must resolve to a canonical Phase 10 connector.

validationRules.description: connectorId must resolve to an existing Phase 10 Integration connector.
Declaring support does not mean the customer has connected or authorized the external account.
Credentials and secrets are prohibited from Integration Support declarations.

delivery.notes: Manifest definitions contain technical declarations only. Secret values are prohibited.
